description: EB3 linear scalar perturbations propagated on a fixed GeNeSyS background. This configuration is purely kinematic and diagnostic. No background parameter (gamma, beta, m, H0) is fixed or tuned here.

perturbations.notes: Mukhanov–Sasaki equation rewritten for the comoving curvature. Initial conditions are imposed on v_k in the Bunch–Davies vacuum and converted analytically to R_k.

k_description: Comoving wavenumbers expressed in the same conformal-time units as eta. No implicit H0 rescaling is assumed in the code.

initial_conditions.description: Vacuum initial conditions imposed as early as possible on v_k. No assumption is made that all modes satisfy k >> aH; modes violating numerical stability are rejected.

integration.description: Strict integration policy. Any floating-point anomaly (overflow, invalid, divide-by-zero) aborts the mode to prevent unphysical spectra.

normalization.notes: No amplitude fitting or observational calibration is performed in EB3.

continuity.EB0: background geometry from pipeline (E, R, eta)
